description: This Java source file defines the ProfesorController class, which manages web endpoints related to 'Profesor' entities in a Spring MVC application. It includes methods for CRUD operations, associating with services and repositories, and securing endpoints with role-based annotations.

classes.name: ProfesorController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling CRUD operations and web endpoints for managing Profesor entities, secured with role-based access.

methods.name: addProfesor
methods.description: Displays a form for adding a new Profesor, accessible to users with ROLE_USER.

methods.name: saveProfesor
methods.description: Handles the submission of a new Profesor, creating it via the service layer.

methods.name: getProfesorForUpdate
methods.description: Retrieves a Profesor by ID for editing purposes, accessible to ROLE_ADMIN.

methods.name: updateProfesor
methods.description: Updates an existing Profesor with new data, identified by ID, accessible to ROLE_ADMIN.

methods.name: patchProfesor
methods.description: Partially updates a Profesor's details and persists changes.

methods.name: getProfesoresList
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of all Profesors, accessible to ROLE_USER.

methods.name: deleteProfesor
methods.description: Deletes a Profesor by ID, accessible to ROLE_ADMIN.

methods.name: getProfesorDetail
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific Profesor, including associated Cursos, accessible to ROLE_USER.
